requirements.statement: Ledger rules and storage execute in runtime Wasm. The P0/Sapling build uses rustc 1.85.0, the pinned SDK and only baseline Substrate imports; any later node extension exposes curve math only, never ledger rules.
requirements.counterexample: A runtime imports a native apply_ledger operation or a pure-Wasm build links a new host call.

requirements.statement: The first hub release includes a real foreign GRANDPA finality and inclusion consumer: pinned chain/checkpoint, signed authority transitions, quorum weights, bounded history and canonical inclusion. It refuses wrong chain/set/root, duplicate signers, insufficient quorum, stale checkpoints and unsupported changes.
requirements.counterexample: An arbitrary valid proof or a committee signature is accepted as another chain's canonical finalized event.

requirements.statement: Statements bind chain genesis, checkpoint, height, root, backend/version, VK, public inputs and consumer domain. Consumers pin keys and trust class; unknown/deprecated/oversized inputs fail closed. Existing BN254 receipt bytes and meaning remain unchanged. One identical Groth16 proof is accepted in runtime Wasm and the Cardano evaluator and confirmed on both preprod chains with block/transaction evidence, with tampered cases refused.
requirements.counterexample: A CommitteeAttested Compact claim is relabeled trustless, a foreign VK satisfies a consumer, or old receipt tags change meaning.

requirements.statement: Before Lane S proceeds, build no_std Wasm and accept at least 20 distinct provenance-pinned real Zcash mainnet Sapling proofs; reject every single-bit mutation of each 192-byte proof with fixed inputs. Benchmark 100 full 1-spend/2-output bundles including signatures on the reviewed slowest hardware. Maximum <=150 ms permits normal progression; >150 to <=400 ms requires tighter caps and earlier acceleration; >400 ms refuses the pure-Wasm path. Caps use <=750 ms normal budget and measured declared weights; total runtime <=5 MiB.
requirements.counterexample: A native arkworks microbenchmark or generated trivial circuit is cited as the Sapling-in-Wasm result.

requirements.statement: With emissions disabled in the bounded test, 10,000 actual Wasm A/U/S transitions preserve initial issuance, U escrow = sum live UTXOs, S escrow = shields minus unshields and controlled-wallet unspent notes. Exclude escrows from A totals and MOTRA generation. Invalid transactions roll back value/nullifier changes; exercise overflow, dust, reserved balances and partial-failure boundaries. Production mint/burn policies remain separately accounted.
requirements.counterexample: A custody transfer increases TotalIssuance, counts an escrow twice, or an invalid spend removes a nullifier while leaving its debit.

requirements.statement: A build profile excluding every Midnight adapter completes nonempty shielded, hybrid, fee and offline foreign-finality scenarios in an isolated network namespace with no external route. Active probes to Midnight hosts and a direct external IP must fail before scenario success is credited. No runtime SRS fetch is allowed.
requirements.counterexample: A hosts-file entry is called a blackhole while cached DNS, direct IP or an untested empty profile still reaches Midnight.

requirements.statement: Actual old and candidate runtime metadata preserve existing pallet, call, event, error and storage encodings; append new pallets >=26 with unique indices. Keep SignedExtra and transaction_version unchanged. Exercise migration state and the #494 gate; shifted variants, stale manifests and unreviewed shrinks must refuse. This does not replace source/origin review.
requirements.counterexample: Adding an error in the middle shifts existing DispatchError indices, or a missing metadata tool reports green.

requirements.statement: The reviewed post-AJ launch node/runtime/genesis/metadata/import artifacts remain identical when ZK preprod work is built. Baseline must include all eight #66 tests; the preprod artifact must positively contain the new capabilities while launch contains none. Each artifact-contamination mutant must fail isolation. Missing reviewed hashes are RED.
requirements.counterexample: Isolation freezes vulnerable 52829ca or both build profiles silently omit the new feature and compare equal.

requirements.statement: Canonical v1 Account and Utxo recipients round-trip byte-identically through production Rust and Aiken codecs. Reserved Shielded, unknown version/tag/lock, wrong lengths, trailing bytes and noncanonical integers are rejected without account fallback. A future reserved-tag implementation requires a reviewed contract/version decision.
requirements.counterexample: Unknown recipient bytes decode as Account and lock value to the wrong owner.

requirements.statement: AJ's eight exact accrual regressions must be compiled and run in this checkout: fresh funding, ten-account cycling, top-up, sovereign exclusion, projection agreement, creation clock, leave/return interval and sovereign delegation. Zero selected or ignored tests fail. The reviewed genesis includes AJ's fix; this packet implements none of it.
requirements.counterexample: cargo test with a misspelled filter reports zero tests and the launch packet treats it as exploit closure.

requirements.statement: Zero-congestion verification costs more MOTRA than an equal-length transfer; an admitted invalid proof still pays, no MATRA tx fee is charged, and a fresh zero-MOTRA owner succeeds through an authorized funded sponsor. Unauthorized sponsors fail. 10,000 malformed admissions invoke zero cryptographic verifications and accepted ZK weight stays within half the normal budget and the slot time.
requirements.counterexample: Anyone can charge a victim by naming it as sponsor, or expensive malformed proofs consume CPU before structural bounds.

requirements.statement: Atomic HybridTx implements A-U-S-U-A with conserved value. Four submitters include 200 independent owner spends without owner nonce priority errors; conflicting inputs and replayed network/txhash/index bridge deposits credit once. Account-only intents have replay protection; wrong CIP-8 key/domain/network, expiry and wrong genesis reject. Exercise a real CIP-30 test wallet signature on preprod.
requirements.counterexample: Two distinct pending spends of the same outpoint both receive valid pool tags, or a Cardano mainnet outpoint aliases a preprod deposit.

requirements.statement: Preprod shields 100 MATRA from A, privately transfers to B through an open relayer and unshields to C with unchanged issuance, correct escrow, recipient decryption and viewing-key history. Bind chain/protocol, all actions, outputs, recipient and fee authorization in signatures. Reject doubles, stale roots, wrong genesis, signatures, caps and pause. Require seven days with >=500 finalized bundles and zero invariant/import failures including arm64; do not claim anonymity from low traffic. Reject non-MATRA assets. Notes created before an unrelated runtime upgrade remain spendable under the same explicit note-protocol version.
requirements.counterexample: A valid proof is redirected to another unshield recipient, a paused lane accepts value, or a seven-day idle chain counts as a soak.

requirements.statement: A future RFC-163 math-only extension requires 10,000 differential cases on x86_64, arm64 and emulated arm64, authenticated full role inventory for seven days and 24 hours without post-swap import failures. One lagging/stale/missing author, voter, RPC or external SPO refuses activation. Exercise only isolated devnet in this check; mainnet remains blocked.
requirements.counterexample: Version strings from reachable authors alone are treated as complete coverage and a voter cannot import the upgrade.

requirements.statement: No spend, audit/counsel engagement, external promise, mainnet artifact change or activation is authorized by this packet. A zero-broadcast activation simulation refuses absent CEO approval, budget, counsel, audit, 30-day Lane S soak, caps, metadata review, timelock or multisig, and any open HIGH/MEDIUM audit finding. Real evidence and explicit authority are still required outside the simulation.
requirements.counterexample: A lock digest or an all-green mock simulation is used as approval to engage a vendor or broadcast a mainnet transaction.

challenges.claim: Security C01: A valid Groth16 proof proves foreign-chain finality.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. r-other-chains requires chain/checkpoint/authority transitions and inclusion; r-hub-domains binds proof claims separately. No automatic bridge credit follows.

challenges.claim: Security C02: A balanced public escrow proves no counterfeit hidden notes exist.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. r-supply limits its claim to custody conservation and controlled-wallet witnesses. Hidden-note soundness still depends on the relation, setup, encodings and audit; caps bound only value release, not downstream damage.

challenges.claim: Security C03: A last/current minimum still permits leave-and-return MOTRA farming between touches.
challenges.resolution: ACCEPTED. Require every eligible balance transition accounted for and AJ's exact round-trip/delegation regressions; do not duplicate AJ's implementation.

challenges.claim: Security C04: Reuse of Sapling allows arbitrary circuit edits without new setup review.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. Baseline relation stays unchanged; version and hash-pin parameters/VKs, reject noncanonical encodings and test every proof-bit mutant. New asset/fee circuits require a new packet and reviewed parameters.

challenges.claim: Security C05: Put consumed outpoints only in requires tags.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. Consumed outpoints and sponsor vouchers must conflict through provides-style tags, then be rechecked at dispatch. Account-only intents need separate replay protection.

challenges.claim: Security C06: Delegatees permits taking fees from any named sponsor.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. It routes generation; it does not authorize arbitrary third-party debits. Signed relayers pay their own MOTRA and unsigned Lane U requires authenticated single-use fee authorization.

challenges.claim: Security C07: Permissionless VK registration should authorize every consumer.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. Registration deposits bound storage; each consumer pins backend/version/VK/domain/trust. Committee and hardware attestations cannot become consensus proofs by relabeling.

challenges.claim: Security C08: Mutation testing and invariant success replace independent audit.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. Tests cover bounded domains. d-audit remains blocked for booking and requires independent integration review before value-bearing activation.

challenges.claim: Security C22: Binding note identity to runtime spec_version could strand notes after unrelated upgrades.
challenges.resolution: ACCEPTED. Use an explicit note-protocol signing domain with chain genesis and all spend effects, not automatic note identity changes on each runtime release. r-shielded-runtime adds an old-note spend witness across an unrelated pallet append; actual protocol migrations require separate review.

challenges.claim: Launch/operations C09: Freezing the base revision would preserve the MOTRA exploit.
challenges.resolution: ACCEPTED. The reviewed launch baseline must first include AJ's fix. ZK then proves isolation against that baseline. Missing reviewed artifacts remain RED.

challenges.claim: Launch/operations C10: Disabled ZK genesis code is equivalent to absent code.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. Preserve launch node/runtime/genesis/metadata/import bytes; positive preprod capability is required to avoid identical empty builds passing.

challenges.claim: Launch/operations C11: Even default-off new host imports can halt unupgraded nodes at instantiation.
challenges.resolution: ACCEPTED. Ship arithmetic dark and activate imports only after complete authenticated role coverage and differential/devnet evidence.

challenges.claim: Launch/operations C12: Reserved Shielded datum tag ensures a future immutable validator can process it.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. Reserved means rejected. Future semantics require a new reviewed version/contract decision; unknown data cannot fall back to accounts.

challenges.claim: Launch/operations C13: A generated #494 manifest is sufficient authority to upgrade.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. Test actual append-only metadata and mutants, preserve envelope, inspect migration state and require independent origin/source review and applicable timelock/multisig. No ceremony occurs here.

challenges.claim: Launch/operations C14: A locked recommendation authorizes counsel, audit or mainnet work.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. d-compliance, d-audit, d-budget and d-mainnet-rollout remain blocked. Their recommendations are filled but authority must be explicit.

challenges.claim: Feasibility/evidence C15: The native 2.41 ms arkworks result does not measure a full Sapling Wasm bundle.
challenges.resolution: ACCEPTED. Recorded as unreplicated study evidence only. Require signatures, encodings, tree costs and slowest-hardware samples; thresholds are policy, not measurements.

challenges.claim: Feasibility/evidence C16: Other-chain priority warrants shipping all five backends together.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. d-order selects a narrow hub with a real foreign-chain consumer plus parallel Sapling spike; backend-specific gates avoid a generic registry without users.

challenges.claim: Feasibility/evidence C17: A hosts file or no-op optional test proves Midnight independence.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. r-midnight-independent requires isolated no-egress execution, positive denial probes, excluded dependencies and named nonempty core scenarios.

challenges.claim: Feasibility/evidence C18: Exit zero, names or empty JSON can make a vacuous test look successful.
challenges.resolution: ACCEPTED. Reject missing drivers, timeouts, zero/ignored tests, unknown statuses and malformed/duplicate-key responses. Assert actual state transitions; list and run AJ tests exactly. Driver correspondence still needs review and real artifacts.

challenges.claim: Feasibility/evidence C19: An orphaned BLS library means Mithril support is ready.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED. Official STM docs confirm a BLS12-381 backend, narrowing the study uncertainty. Wasm portability, certificate chains, stake/checkpoint semantics and bounded costs remain a separately gated spike.

challenges.claim: Feasibility/evidence C20: Trustworthy evidence must distinguish scaffold readiness from implementation readiness.
challenges.resolution: ACCEPTED. Adapter unit tests may become GREEN; every feature check stays RED until its real dependencies and assertions run. No --run, live chain experiment or production assurance claim is made by this pass.

challenges.claim: Feasibility/evidence C21: The exact supplied runner accepts blocked decisions and uppercase D- ids at lock time.
challenges.resolution: REJECTED by inspected code: FluxPoint 1.42.0 accepts only defaulted/user-confirmed statuses and lowercase kebab-case ids. IDs are normalized to d-* with the same meaning. Literal blocked statuses are preserved pending the user's answer; no lock digest is fabricated or validator patched.
